mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_consult (student_name, consult_date, school, grade_no, phone, inflow_route_no, content, created_at) VALUES (#{studentName}, #{consultDate}, #{school}, #{gradeNo}, #{phone}, #{inflowRouteNo}, #{content}, SYSDATETIME());
mapper.select: SELECT c.consult_key AS consultKey, c.student_name AS studentName, c.consult_date AS consultDate, c.school AS school, c.phone AS phone, c.content AS content, g.grade_name AS gradeName, i.inflow_route_name AS inflowRouteName FROM ERP_CONSULT c JOIN erp_grade_code g ON c.grade_key = g.grade_key JOIN erp_inflow_route i ON c.inflow_route_key = i.inflow_route_key
